capabilities: Overlay a clear reading band that dims surrounding text in notes and PDFs
Follow the pointer, Apple Pencil hover, or rest at a fixed height with a drag handle
Pin, resize, tint, and set the width of the band via commands and settings
Keep input working through the band and give each pane its own ruler
Optionally follow the caret while editing
extras: README states the plugin makes no network requests and collects no data; it includes detailed desktop and iPad manual test checklists plus developer release/submission instructions. Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep your place while reading long notes or dense PDFs on desktop or mobile.
summary: Reading ruler that shows a clear horizontal band at reading height while dimming the rest of the text in Markdown notes and PDFs.
